title: The text API found its voice
summary:
This week added a voice to the text API while making model routing and chat tools more predictable.

`openai-audio` added speech generation with selectable voices and binary audio responses. Streams default to PCM16, non-streaming responses to MP3, and callers can choose their own audio settings.

Phi-4 Multimodal Instruct joined chat as `phi`. Routing work moved `llama`, Scaleway-backed models, and the former Cloudflare client onto the existing Portkey route while retaining model-specific prompts. `claude-hybridspace` was renamed `claude`, so callers using the old name need to update it.

The text API now forwards `tools` and `tool_choice`. Search also preserves options such as response format on follow-ups, supplies the current date when needed, and makes sequential tool calls through its default search tool.

The README and website now list 1038lab’s ComfyUI-Pollinations node and isinry’s Chinese-language tutorial for adding image generation to a DeepSeek chat UI.
